_comment: tools/levelstats.sh (tools/levelstats/level_stats.gd). How the per-level report counts; docs/plan-longer-levels.md is what it is held against.
_near_hazard_tiles: A hazard tile is 'near the route' when it lies within this many tiles of Kaya's body on any frame of the proof tape: close enough that a mistimed jump or a step too far meets it. 2 is a human jump's horizontal overshoot at a run (about 30 px) rounded up to whole tiles.
_targets: The plan's targets, printed under the table so a reader does not have to remember them: route seconds per level, and screens per level.
